milestone.name: Finish source-pinned native-IDB-API-style transaction algorithm with 60 simulated async atomicity tests, 573 source rows, 16 separate dual variants and independent fresh-extract reproducer

verification_evidence: Exact source catalog SHA256 d4b39ca9c25fd1f476cfc10b7aac251b76fcda352b8cf705ac67ba7bf32c9636; independent cross-deck original ZIP row reconstruction PASS 573/573, 2292 original example references, 128 exact colliding triplets.

Source-validating IndexedDB API request-callback implementation and deterministic fake IDB queue tests PASS 60/60 (27 each import order, 6 schema/catalog); no app import, no real origin, no user profile.

Pretransaction SHA256 pin of complete 178/395 source batches rejects unauthorized edits before opening any transaction; duplicate/missing source rows and display-source selection cause fail-closed behavior.

Fake IDB rolls back all staged variant/identity/control writes on errors after multiple positions and simulated quota/IO failures. Serialized synthetic generation-CAS rejects stale concurrent writes. Reimport replay idempotent.

Transient SRS object store seeded with 178 or 395 distinct review objects; same serialized review data survive all accepted cases and all aborts. Proposed algorithm never requests existing app `reviewStates`/`libraryCards` stores.
Older 42/42 SQLite transaction prototype and independent 573-parent-source reconstructor rerun PASS, but neither substitutes for actual browser IndexedDB test.

Compact 118104-byte 15-member ZIP SHA256 90c1649eeb882760a87438b91bdfb8b00efb0c9299c8ad515eb9b93b1a31f51b, 13 manifest members / SHA256SUMS full check, fresh extraction + Node 60/60 + independent Python + outcome-accounting validator PASS. Library upload and rematerialization byte-identical.

Exact CURRENT v485-R119 app IDB namespace GermanFlashcardsProDB_v6 schema version 9, protected store names inspected read-only; proposed new stores not deployed; original LOCKED/audio/user SRS/UI and global B1 LATEST unchanged.
risk_boundaries: Fake IDB request/queue model is not Chrome IndexedDB and cannot prove true quota, browser eviction, persistent reload, versionchange or multi-tab durability.
Sidecar proposal holds source metadata; complete example bodies outside the 16 collisions remain referenced via exact source ZIP digests. It does not create/deploy a fully merged card.
Production deployment would require architecture permission, approved IndexedDB same-db schema upgrade and actual real-origin non-destructive SRS tests.
